page: Microsoft Azure M96s_2_v3 is a high-capacity virtual machine in the MSMediumMemoryv3 family, engineered specifically for memory-intensive enterprise environments. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance leverages an x86_64 Intel processor architecture providing 96 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory totals 1,946.0 GB, yielding a high ratio of approximately 20.27 GB of RAM per vCPU, designed to maintain large datasets entirely in system memory.

Hardware specifications indicate that the server does not bundle local ephemeral storage, relying instead on network-attached Premium Storage capabilities for persistence and operating system disks. Hardware acceleration is not present, with zero physical or virtual GPUs configured. Furthermore, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard Azure virtual network routing or allocated IP configurations for public connectivity.

From an efficiency standpoint, the dedicated 96 vCPU allocation combined with nearly two terabytes of memory optimizes resource utilization for organizations consolidating large memory pools on a single operating system instance. The trade-off of having no integrated local storage requires reliance on remote storage fabrics, shifting I/O throughput to attached storage performance. Consequently, this server profile is tailored for large-scale in-memory databases, extensive caching layers, enterprise resource planning platforms, and large data warehousing workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure M96s_2_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the MSMediumMemoryv3 family, running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The hardware profile features an x86_64 Intel processor delivering 96 dedicated vCPUs paired with 1,946.0 GB of system RAM, resulting in a high density of approximately 20.27 GB of memory per core. The server includes no onboard graphical processing units and supplies no local ephemeral storage, directing persistent and temporary disk operations to external Premium Storage volumes. Network configurations provision zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By prioritizing memory capacity alongside high core counts, the architecture avoids compute-to-memory bottlenecks for workloads requiring massive working datasets. The M96s_2_v3 is primarily designed for enterprise-grade applications including large-scale in-memory databases, business transaction systems, extensive caching clusters, data warehousing operations, and memory-intensive enterprise resource planning platforms.
